root = Stack([pageTitle, contentCard])
$searchTerm = ""

pageTitle = TextContent("Recent Transactions", "large-heavy")

contentCard = Card([
    searchControl,
    filteredTransactionsTable
])

searchControl = FormControl(
    "Search Description",
    Input("search", "Enter description to search...", "text", null, $searchTerm),
    "Filter transactions by description"
)

transactionsData = [
    {id: "T001", date: "2024-07-28", description: "Office Supplies - Staples", amount: 120.50, type: "expense"},
    {id: "T002", date: "2024-07-27", description: "Consulting Fee - Project Alpha", amount: 2500.00, type: "income"},
    {id: "T003", date: "2024-07-26", description: "Utilities - Electricity Bill", amount: 85.20, type: "expense"},
    {id: "T004", date: "2024-07-26", description: "Software Subscription - CloudApp", amount: 49.99, type: "expense"},
    {id: "T005", date: "2024-07-25", description: "Reimbursement - Travel", amount: 350.00, type: "income"},
    {id: "T006", date: "2024-07-24", description: "Internet Service", amount: 75.00, type: "expense"},
    {id: "T007", date: "2024-07-23", description: "Client Payment - Design Project", amount: 1500.00, type: "income"},
    {id: "T008", date: "2024-07-22", description: "Lunch with Client", amount: 65.75, type: "expense"},
    {id: "T009", date: "2024-07-21", description: "Bank Transfer - Payroll", amount: 1200.00, type: "expense"},
    {id: "T010", date: "2024-07-20", description: "Office Rent", amount: 800.00, type: "expense"}
]

// Filter transactions based on $searchTerm
filteredTransactions = @Filter(transactionsData, "description", "contains", $searchTerm)

// Sort transactions by date descending
sortedTransactions = @Sort(filteredTransactions, "date", "desc")

filteredTransactionsTable = @Count(sortedTransactions) > 0 ? Table([
    Col("Date", sortedTransactions.date),
    Col("Description", sortedTransactions.description),
    Col("Amount", @Each(sortedTransactions, "tx", TextContent((tx.type == "expense" ? "-" : "+") + "$" + tx.amount, null))),
    Col("Type", @Each(sortedTransactions, "tx", Tag(tx.type, null, "sm", tx.type == "income" ? "success" : "danger")))
]) : TextContent("No transactions found matching your search.", "small")
